description: Java class defining the UpdateThing command for triggering search index updates for a 'thing' within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances, JSON serialization/deserialization, and metadata about the command.

classes.name: UpdateThing
classes.description: Final class representing a command to update a 'thing' in the search index, including creation, JSON serialization, and metadata methods.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an UpdateThing command with specified ThingId and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an UpdateThing instance from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes the command payload into JSON, including the thingId.

methods.name: getTypePrefix
methods.description: Returns the type prefix for this command.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, which is MODIFY.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new UpdateThing instance with updated headers.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the entity ID associated with this command, which is the thingId.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer resource path, empty in this case.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the resource type string for this command.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on thingId and superclass equality.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on thingId and superclass hash.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the UpdateThing object.
